tasks.label: agent-write-probe2
tasks.command:
$p = '.agent/_agent_probe_schema.ps1'; @'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
Import-Module ./src/PS.DrawIO.Core.psd1 -Force
$mod = Get-Module PS.DrawIO.Core
& $mod {
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Private/Resolve-PSDrawIOSchemaPath.ps1')
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Private/Test-PSDrawIODiagramStructuralRoot.ps1')
    . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Public/Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema.ps1')
}
$bareIr = [pscustomobject]@{
    Nodes = @([pscustomobject]@{ Id='n1'; Label='Bare'; Style='whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;'; X=10; Y=10; Width=80; Height=40; Metadata=[pscustomobject]@{} })
    Edges = @()
}
$uoIr = [pscustomobject]@{
    Nodes = @([pscustomobject]@{ Id='n1'; Label='Wrapped'; Style='whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;'; X=10; Y=10; Width=80; Height=40; Link='vscode://file/x.ps1:1'; Metadata=[pscustomobject]@{ XmlAttributes=[pscustomobject]@{ customAttr='keep-me' } } })
    Edges = @()
}
$bareXml = & $mod { param($ir) ConvertTo-PSDrawIODiagramXml -IR $ir } $bareIr
$uoXml = & $mod { param($ir) ConvertTo-PSDrawIODiagramXml -IR $ir } $uoIr
Write-Output '---BARE---'
Write-Output $bareXml
Write-Output '---UO---'
Write-Output $uoXml
try { & $mod { param($c) Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema -Content $c } $bareXml | Out-Null; Write-Output 'BARE_VALID=OK' } catch { Write-Output ("BARE_VALID=FAIL {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) }
try { & $mod { param($c) Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema -Content $c } $uoXml | Out-Null; Write-Output 'UO_VALID=OK' } catch { Write-Output ("UO_VALID=FAIL {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) }
$g = Get-Content -LiteralPath ./tests/Fixtures/Golden/hand-unknown-attrs.drawio -Raw
Write-Output '---GOLDEN---'
Write-Output $g
try { & $mod { param($c) Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema -Content $c } $g | Out-Null; Write-Output 'GOLDEN_UNKNOWN_VALID=OK' } catch { Write-Output ("GOLDEN_UNKNOWN_VALID=FAIL {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) }
$graph = [pscustomobject]@{ Provider='Demo'; Nodes=@([pscustomobject]@{ Id='Demo:Widget:Get-Item'; Type='Widget'; Name='Get-Item'; Label='Get-Item' }, [pscustomobject]@{ Id='Demo:Widget:Set-Item'; Type='Widget'; Name='Set-Item'; Label='Set-Item' }); Edges=@([pscustomobject]@{ From='Demo:Widget:Get-Item'; To='Demo:Widget:Set-Item'; Type='DependsOn' }) }
$ir = ConvertTo-PSDrawIOIR -Graph $graph -Provider Demo
$laid = Invoke-PSDrawIOLayout -IR $ir
$accXml = & $mod { param($i) ConvertTo-PSDrawIODiagramXml -IR $i } $laid
Write-Output '---ACC---'
Write-Output $accXml
try { & $mod { param($c) Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema -Content $c } $accXml | Out-Null; Write-Output 'ACC_VALID=OK' } catch { Write-Output ("ACC_VALID=FAIL {0}" -f $_.Exception.Message) }
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $p -Encoding utf8; & 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $p

Write-Output '---ACC---'

try { & $mod { param($c) Test-PSDrawIODiagramSchema -Content $c } $accXml | Out-Null; 'ACC_VALID=OK' } catch { 'ACC_VALID=FAIL ' + $_.Exception.Message }
